CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tmp_jdisease  (
HOSPCODE VARCHAR(5) NOT NULL , 
PID VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL , 
CID VARCHAR(13) NOT NULL , 
SOURCE VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL ,  
SEQ_AN VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL ,  
DATE_SERV DATE,
DIAGCODE VARCHAR(7) NOT NULL ,  
DIAGTYPE  VARCHAR(1) DEFAULT NULL ,  
PROVIDER  VARCHAR(15) DEFAULT NULL ,  
DEATH_DATE DATE DEFAULT NULL ,
PRIMARY KEY (HOSPCODE,PID,SEQ_AN,DIAGCODE),

) ENGINE=MyISAM  DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;
 
INSERT IGNORE INTO tmp_jdisease 
(SELECT HOSPCODE,PID,CID,'OPD' as source,SEQ,DATE_SERV,DIAGCODE,DIAGTYPE,PROVIDER,null
FROM tmp_diag_opd  d INNER JOIN chospital h ON d.HOSPCODE=h.hoscode
WHERE d.DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
AND SUBSTR(d.diagcode,1,4) in('J028','J128','U071','Z115','B972')
);

INSERT IGNORE INTO tmp_jdisease 
(SELECT a.HOSPCODE,a.PID,a.CID,'IPD' as source,a.AN,DATE(a.DATETIME_DISCH)
,d.DIAGCODE,d.DIAGTYPE,d.PROVIDER,null
FROM tmp_diag_ipd  d INNER JOIN chospital h ON d.HOSPCODE=h.hoscode
INNER JOIN tmp_admission a ON d.HOSPCODE=a.HOSPCODE AND d.an=a.an
WHERE DATE(a.DATETIME_DISCH) BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
AND SUBSTR(d.diagcode,1,4) in('J028','J128','U071','Z115','B972')
);

SET t.DEATH_DATE=s.DATE_SERV
WHERE s.TYPEOUT IN(4,5,6);
